description: Stadt Troisdorf - E-Ladesäulen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Troisdorf. The file contains the e-charging stations in the urban area of the city of Troisdorf. The dataset includes the following attributes: Name, operator, address, payment option, further link (URL), parking spaces, plugs, opening hours, geographical coordinates of the location. Coverage: Stadt Troisdorf. The portal shows the English title as "City of Troisdorf - E-charging stations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stadt Troisdorf. Its keywords include Troisdorf, Verkehr, Autos, Tankstelle, Straßen, opendata. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-01-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
